id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a71: "To think the day would really come when I can become a Bouncy Babe.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a78: "...But why did old men who want to be Bouncy Babes suddenly gather from all over the world?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a8f: "Hi there! I'm a talking horse! I love chatting! Ask me anything! Anything you want to ask me?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a9a: "What?! Nothing?! In front of a talking horse?! Mister, you're way too cool!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2aa8: "What?! There is? What was my first spoken word?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2aad: "Obviously! 'I love delicious carrots!' Because I'm a horse! Heh heh heh!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ac1: "Hi there! I'm a talking horse! I love chatting! Ask me anything!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ac8: "...What? The golden mane that the watchdog of the tower where a sky-galloping horse lives has?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ad1: "Ah, a sky-galloping horse means Pegasus Tower! And its watchdog is the Flamedog that hushes crying kids!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ae0: "The golden mane must be the shining golden mane they sometimes drop!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ae9: "If you keep defeating Flamedogs, you'll get it someday! They're fierce, so good luck!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2af6: "You got the golden mane! Flamedogs are fierce, so I was a little worried!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b1a: "You seem to be in your right mind. Sorry for saying this so suddenly. The townspeople have gone strange.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b26: "I'm about to marry a man named Ortega here in Aliahan...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b2e: "The townspeople who blessed us so warmly suddenly came this morning to oppose the marriage.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b3b: "Some give reasonable reasons, but such trifles hardly matter. Ortega is brave and admirable.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b47: "Everyone in town should know that. For them to suddenly badmouth Ortega, they must have lost their minds.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b56: "I once heard that people under an evil spell lose their senses and say things they don't mean.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b64: "And that with a mystic medicine called angel's smelling salts, people who lost their senses can be restored...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b72: "Traveler, please. In my powerless place, could you look for angel's smelling salts?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b87: "I see... I don't even know if angel's smelling salts really exist. Sorry for asking this.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b93: "Ortega went off to defeat a monster at the king's order and won't be back for a while... I have no one else to ask.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2baa: "Oh! You believe such a story? You too must have had many strange experiences like Ortega.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2bb5: "Angel's smelling salts are said to be in a place high in the sky where angels live.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2bbf: "I don't know how one gets there, but if you reach the angels, please get angel's smelling salts.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2bd6: "No matter what is said, my feelings won't change. I want to support Ortega, who risks his body for people in trouble.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2be4: "But with the townspeople opposing like that, we may never get permission to marry...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2bef: "Please! To restore the townspeople's senses, get angel's smelling salts in the place where angels live.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c06: "I don't know whether the monster's story is true, that when Ortega and I marry, a hero will be born.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c12: "But I learned that monsters fear not only Ortega but his descendants too.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c1b: "I must grow stronger to protect my family. And I'll gently embrace our child, who faces great trials, and raise them strong.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c3a: "Ortega is this old man's son! I raised him hard to be a fine man, but I never knew everyone disliked him so...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c5e: "Ortega is this old man's son! I raised him hard to be a fine man, but I never knew everyone disliked him so...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ce3: "Ortega is this old man's son! I raised him hard to be a fine man, but I never knew everyone disliked him so...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c49: "If this marriage goes ahead, the kind girl next door will be unhappy. Sadly, I should stop my son's marriage.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c6c: "If this marriage goes ahead, the kind girl next door will be unhappy. Sadly, I should stop my son's marriage.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cf1: "If this marriage goes ahead, the kind girl next door will be unhappy. Sadly, I should stop my son's marriage.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c7a: "By the way, you look like you want to ask me something. What is it?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d6e: "By the way, you look like you want to ask me something. What is it?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c86: "I see. Never mind if I only imagined it.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d7b: "I see. Never mind if I only imagined it.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c99: "W-what?! You say you're looking for a book that changes personality?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d8d: "W-what?! You say you're looking for a book that changes personality?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ca0: "Hmmm... impressive. How did you find out my secret...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d95: "Hmmm... impressive. How did you find out my secret...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ca6: "If you've found out, so be it. I'll give it to you gladly!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d9a: "If you've found out, so be it. I'll give it to you gladly!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cb0: "I worried and suffered that someone would say my son is so fine, but his father...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2da5: "I worried and suffered that someone would say my son is so fine, but his father...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cbd: "A few years ago I read that and improved my personality! Now I'm broad-minded, strong, and don't sweat small things!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2db1: "A few years ago I read that and improved my personality! Now I'm broad-minded, strong, and don't sweat small things!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ccb: "Well... now the villagers badmouth my son and oppose the marriage, so my heart is nearly broken... boo hoo.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d00: "By the way, the personality-changing book I have is only the "Secrets of the Mighty" I gave you.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2dfc: "By the way, the personality-changing book I have is only the "Secrets of the Mighty" I gave you.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d0a: "I've heard there are a few other kinds, but I don't know where they are.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e06: "I've heard there are a few other kinds, but I don't know where they are.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d1f: "I'm truly relieved. My son isn't disliked by everyone... I'm glad they bless the marriage.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d4b: "I'm truly relieved. My son isn't disliked by everyone... I'm glad they bless the marriage.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2dd9: "I'm truly relieved. My son isn't disliked by everyone... I'm glad they bless the marriage.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d2b: "Still, why didn't it confuse me or the girl? If it had, it could have surely stopped the marriage...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d57: "Still, why didn't it confuse me or the girl? If it had, it could have surely stopped the marriage...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2de5: "Still, why didn't it confuse me or the girl? If it had, it could have surely stopped the marriage...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d38: "Hmm... either the monster was a fool or we resisted the confusion spell. One or the other...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2df2: "Hmm... either the monster was a fool or we resisted the confusion spell. One or the other...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2dc0: "Well... when the villagers badmouthed my son and opposed the marriage, my heart nearly broke! Ha ha!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e18: "I oppose the marriage! Ortega leaving descendants is outrageous! One dangerous fellow like Ortega is enough.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e2e: "Ortega is too rough and has not a scrap of romance. Such a man doesn't understand a woman's heart.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e39: "If he marries, he'll surely leave his wife lonely all the time! A man like that should stay single forever.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e51: "Before him, even the hottest love song would fade.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e62: "Ortega has no money. He uses ancient equipment and buys only cheap things at my shop...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e71: "A happy married life needs money! Marry Ortega and hardship is obvious!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e83: "Ortega is sincere and well-respected. With him, you'd surely build a happy home!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e99: "The wedding is soon, yet Ortega is off traveling again, they say!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ea1: "Marrying someone who's always away, what's the point! If you marry, you'd best pick a man who cherishes home!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2eb3: "The wedding is soon! How joyous! I always thought those two were a good match.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ed0: "What a pickle... Oh, you look quite skilled. Please hear my story.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2edb: "This castle was Baramos's base, but it was originally the castle of the Kingdom of Necrogond, where humans lived.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2eea: "Thanks to the Hero of Aliahan, peace has come, so we gathered here to mourn those whose castle and lives Baramos took.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2efa: "But when we arrived, we were shocked! Corpses are moving around, trying to revive Baramos!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f06: "We can't let Baramos, whom the Hero of Aliahan defeated, be revived so easily! Lend us your strength to stop it?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f1d: "...I see. If you're afraid, it can't be helped. I won't force you...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f2d: "You'll do it? Thank you! Kings and soldiers of other lands should be doing their best in the castle.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f3b: "Hear from them, find the boss trying to revive the Archfiend Baramos, and defeat him! I'm counting on you!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f55: "Peace returned, so we gathered at this castle to mourn those Baramos destroyed...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f63: "Never did I think corpses would move around and try to revive Baramos!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f6c: "Kings and soldiers from other lands should be doing their best in the castle to stop Baramos's revival.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f7b: "Hear from them, find the boss trying to revive the Archfiend Baramos, and defeat him!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f8d: "Baramos can never be revived now. The people of the destroyed Necrogond Kingdom can sleep in peace.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f9b: "We'll mourn this castle's people properly before going home. We won't forget you. Until we meet again!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fb0: "The young soldier who came with me was carried off by the corpses! At this rate, I too... ugh...!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fc1: "The young soldier who came with me was carried off by the corpses! At this rate, I too... ugh...!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fd5: "Thank you for saving me. But what became of the young soldier carried off by the corpses...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fe9: "I see! That young soldier is safe! It's thanks to you. I thank you!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ffd: "Gah, don't startle me! I thought you were a monster!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3005: "If I'd known I'd face such terror, I should have yielded the throne to the Hero of Aliahan back then.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3556: "If I'd known I'd face such terror, I should have yielded the throne to the Hero of Aliahan back then.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3015: "Oh, traveler! You stopped Baramos's revival, didn't you?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|301e: "What a remarkable youth! How about it? Would you rule the Kingdom of Romaly in my place?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|356f: "What a remarkable youth! How about it? Would you rule the Kingdom of Romaly in my place?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|302b: "Ha ha ha. Just joking. You have an important mission, don't you? Continue your journey!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|357e: "Ha ha ha. Just joking. You have an important mission, don't you? Continue your journey!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3043: "I'm a broad-minded king. Even if you're a country bumpkin, I won't look down on you.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|304c: "I know the boss is nearby, but my legs are frozen and I can't go...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|305b: "The terrifying presence vanished so I came... and the monster boss is gone!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3066: "Did you defeat the boss? Country bumpkins are not to be underestimated.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3079: "It seems there's a monster in this castle that revives the dead and controls them...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3083: "If we defeat that one, those being controlled will be freed and Baramos's revival can be stopped!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3095: "I can tell from your eyes. You defeated the monster that revived and controlled the dead.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30a1: "Well done! Thank you for protecting the peace the Hero of Aliahan regained!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30b7: "This is known as Archfiend Baramos's castle. The Hero of Aliahan defeated Baramos, so the monsters should be gone...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30c4: "Something terrible is happening! If you'll lend your strength, hear the details from the king beside me.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30d8: "This castle of the Necrogond Kingdom was built to watch over the Giaga Pit, where all calamities are said to arise.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3120: "This castle of the Necrogond Kingdom was built to watch over the Giaga Pit, where all calamities are said to arise.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30e6: "It sits in a rugged place among rocky mountains and wasn't wealthy, but the kingdom's people were all honest and kind.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30f5: "Those people were destroyed by Baramos, so kings gathered from around the world to mourn, only to find this horror!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3103: "The Hero of Aliahan entered the Giaga Pit to defeat the Archfiend Zoma and hasn't returned. We must do what we can!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3115: "The King of Portoga is waiting. Please go report!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|366b: "The King of Portoga is waiting. Please go report!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|312e: "Baramos destroyed the people, but someday their heirs will gather here and restore Necrogond.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3143: "Hmm... why is there a turtle in such a place...?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36a7: "Hmm... why is there a turtle in such a place...?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3148: "Oh, sorry. I thought I saw something like a turtle through the trees in the far north, but surely I imagined it.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36ac: "Oh, sorry. I thought I saw something like a turtle through the trees in the far north, but surely I imagined it.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|315f: "Corpses carrying a young soldier went down the stairs in the middle of the pond.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3169: "I followed them, but the atmosphere was eerie... I got scared and came back.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3178: "The soldier carried off by monsters was safe. I'm so glad... Thank you.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3192: "They must be sad to be controlled and forced to say things they don't mean.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|319f: "The corpses were wrapped in light and vanished with happy faces. The monster controlling them must have been defeated!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31b5: "The wandering corpses were people of the Necrogond Kingdom revived as monsters...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31c0: "To revive people Baramos killed and make them work for his revival, how cruel...!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31cf: "I'm glad the souls of Necrogond's people were freed...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31d8: "So this never happens again, I'll stay in this castle and keep watch.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31e8: No answer.⏎He seems to have fainted.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31f2: "Huh...? The corpses that were going to sacrifice me are gone... Th-this situation... could it be...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31fc: "Waaah, what do I do! Waking up from fainting to find it all over. A soldier's grave failure...!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|320f: "Someone is speaking directly into my head...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3214: "Rise, people of Necrogond. Revive the Archfiend Baramos and this time you will live happily forever...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3228: "I quit resisting the voice in my head. I'll live easier, freer! Since I got revived!!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|323a: "The ritual to revive Lord Baramos will start soon. No one can stop it.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|324b: "We, the people of Necrogond, watched over the Giaga Pit for world peace so no calamity would arise...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|325a: "But that was meaningless! ...I'll gain power that none can destroy again. From Lord Baramos!!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|326b: "Our prayers and sacrifice will call Lord Baramos's soul back here... Now you too, pray.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|327d: "I don't know why I revived like this. ...But the voice in my head tells me.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3291: "My comrades secured the sacrifice! Until the ritual starts, let's play with this old man.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|329e: "What? I was playing with the old man because my comrades secured a sacrifice... If you interfere, I'll play with you!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32ad: "Forced to be controlled... my heart felt about to shatter... Thank you for stopping me.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32bd: "Ha ha! Scared, scared~? I died once, so I fear nothing! I'll show you this world's terror.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32cc: "Ha ha! I died once, so I fear nothing! I'll show you this world's terror too!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32db: "Thank you... Now I'm free of the voice controlling me...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32ea: "Tch! Living honestly in a country like this brought nothing good...!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32fc: "Tch! Living honestly in a country like this brought nothing good...!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32f0: "From now on, I'll live as I please under Lord Baramos!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3302: "From now on, I'll live as I please under Lord Baramos! First, I'll make you my bloody offering!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3311: "Sorry for attacking... My body wouldn't obey.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3319: "My words were all lies... I'm proud to have been born a citizen of this country...

tm.「まさか ぴちぴちギャルに転職できる日が\n ホントに 来るなんてね。: "To think the day would really come when I can become a Bouncy Babe.
tm.「……それにしても どうして 突然\n ぴちぴちギャルになりたい おじいさんが\: "...But why did old men who want to be Bouncy Babes suddenly gather from all over the world?
tm.「こんちわ！ ぼく しゃべるウマ！\n おしゃべり大好き！ なんでも 聞いてよ！: "Hi there! I'm a talking horse! I love chatting! Ask me anything! Anything you want to ask me?
tm.「え！？ ないの！？\n しゃべるウマを 前にして！？\n お兄さん ちょっと: "What?! Nothing?! In front of a talking horse?! Mister, you're way too cool!
tm.「え！？ あるの！？\n はじめて しゃべった言葉は 何かって？: "What?! There is? What was my first spoken word?
tm.「そんなの 決まってるじゃん！\n ウマい ニンジン大好きっ！ だよ！\n ウマ: "Obviously! 'I love delicious carrots!' Because I'm a horse! Heh heh heh!
tm.「こんちわ！ ぼく しゃべるウマ！\n おしゃべり大好き！ なんでも 聞いてよ！: "Hi there! I'm a talking horse! I love chatting! Ask me anything!
tm.「……え？ 天を駆けるウマが 住まう塔の\n 番犬が持ってる おうごんのたてがみ: "...What? The golden mane that the watchdog of the tower where a sky-galloping horse lives has?
tm.「ああ～ なるほど！ 天を駆けるウマといえば\n ここ天馬の塔！ そして 塔の番: "Ah, a sky-galloping horse means Pegasus Tower! And its watchdog is the Flamedog that hushes crying kids!
tm.「おうごんのたてがみっていうのは\n そいつらが ときどき 落とす\n 金色にか: "The golden mane must be the shining golden mane they sometimes drop!
tm.「フレイムドックを 倒していれば\n いつか 手に入ると思うよ！\n あいつら: "If you keep defeating Flamedogs, you'll get it someday! They're fierce, so good luck!
tm.「おうごんのたてがみ 手に入れたんだね！\n フレイムドックは 凶暴だから\n: "You got the golden mane! Flamedogs are fierce, so I was a little worried!
